datasets.title: South Sudan Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 2.2 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 70% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 6% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and supplemented with AI-mapped estimates to improve coverage. The dataset represents approximately 2.2 million buildings with an average data age of 4 years, exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
